answer: Phase-dispersion admission: gateways score each identity’s inter-arrival autocorrelation and burst-shape entropy from locally seeded request jitter. Independent agents yield a comet-like scattered tail with irregular, heavy-tailed gaps; coordinated sybils collapse into a vine of synchronized pulses, while naive pacing adds a ripple of periodic drift. Admission requires dispersion above threshold. Attackers must give each sybil independent clocks and randomized schedules, absorbing latency and coordination overhead per identity—costly at scale.
